title: Harborline Reseller Program Schedule: Discount on Overdue Web Hosting Plans Renewals
content:
Harborline Reseller Program — overdue hosting renewals.

**Rule.** The overdue renewal amount of a Web Hosting Plans plan takes the reseller discount of the customer's Harborline account tier on the date it is billed: an account on Harborline Reseller Platinum, Harborline Reseller Gold, Harborline Reseller Silver or Harborline Reseller Bronze takes that tier's hosting discount percentage under the Harborline Customer Accounts charter, and a Harborline Personal Account or Harborline Business Account takes no reseller discount. The percentage acts once on the regular price, and the discounted price is rounded half up to the cent before any credit or fee is applied.

| Account tier recorded on the billing date (Harborline Customer Accounts) | Reseller discount on the overdue renewal amount |
|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | 25 percent |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | 20 percent |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | 15 percent |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | 10 percent |
| Harborline Personal Account | none |
| Harborline Business Account | none |

The percentages are each reseller tier's hosting discount percentage in the Harborline Customer Accounts tier discount schedule.

**Illustrations (hypothetical regular prices).**

- Regular price USD 211.30 on a Harborline Reseller Silver account: 85 percent of it is 179.605, rounded half up to USD 179.61.
- Regular price USD 64.20 on a Harborline Reseller Platinum account: 75 percent of it is USD 48.15.
- The same renewal on a Harborline Business Account takes no reseller discount.
- The tier that counts is the one on the account on the date the overdue renewal is billed, not an earlier one.
